description: For an inventory or merchant-ops agent: list forecast-based alerts, the bundles with stockout risk, demand drop, demand spike, or an unreliable forecast curve. Use this when a merchant asks 'what's at risk of stockout?', 'which bundles are losing demand?', 'do I need to reorder anything?', or 'what should I restock?'. Pair with forecast_bundle to drill into a specific bundle. Merchant-ops surface: BigCommerce today; on other platforms merchants manage this from the admin, and the tool returns a clear not-available message.

limit.description: Max alerts to return. Default 10, max 50.

name: get_forecast_alerts
